channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, AI, Tech & Research, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, AI, Tech & Research, US, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 27 Apr 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 27 Apr 2026 (27 Apr to 03 May 2026).

  • AWS Imagine Grant US 2026: Pathfinder Award (Frontier AI)
    Amazon Web Services (AWS Imagine Grant Program) · deadline Closed 05 Jun 2026 · Up to $200,000 USD unrestricted cash + up to $100,000 USD in AWS Promotional Credits + project implementation support from the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center
    https://aws.amazon.com/government-education/nonprofits/aws-imagine-grant-program/
  • AWS Imagine Grant US 2026: Go Further, Faster Award
    Amazon Web Services (AWS Imagine Grant Program) · deadline Closed 05 Jun 2026 · Up to $150,000 USD unrestricted cash + up to $100,000 USD in AWS Promotional Credits + AWS technical specialist guidance
    https://aws.amazon.com/government-education/nonprofits/aws-imagine-grant-program/

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
